product_context: ShopNest is a direct-to-consumer mobile e-commerce brand for sustainable fashion. Target audience: Gen-Z and millennial shoppers on iOS and Android. Quarterly goals: reduce cart abandonment rate below 25%, boost repeat purchase rate, and speed up mobile checkout.
feedback: App crashes immediately on checkout when Apple Pay is selected on iOS 18
Allow 1-click guest checkout without forcing account registration
Fast guest checkout option without creating a password
Show real-time courier tracking map with SMS delivery updates
Add UPI and Google Pay express payment methods at checkout
Include UPI payment QR option on the checkout page
Size recommendation guide based on height, weight, and previous brand purchases
Notify me via push notification when sold-out items in my wishlist are restocked
Wishlist back-in-stock alerts when sizes become available again
Allow split payments across two credit cards or card + gift card
Customer photo and video reviews on product detail pages
Instant returns label generation directly from order history page
Apply discount codes automatically from available coupons banner
Show estimated carbon footprint savings for each sustainable apparel item
Add background chill lofi music to product catalogue
Spin the lucky prize wheel pop-up for free coupons
